name: Yanagisawa Sayoko
source:
A full-time housewife, she has raised her only son, Shun, with great care.

She bakes homemade cookies for snacks and is passionate about education. She has successfully enrolled Shun in a well-known preparatory school.

Now, as if she had reached the end of her child-rearing years, she was spending her days peacefully.

Her husband is currently working overseas.

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp4/game4.html]official site[/url]]
